name: The Scroll Backpack
summary: An expandable leather backpack designed for work, travel and creative life.
description: Crafted from Diesel leather with Crazy Horse leather straps, this backpack's roll-top design gives you flexibility between a compact carry and extra space when you need it. The scroll mechanism is both a closure and a defining aesthetic.
materials: Crazy Horse leather straps and trims
features: Pocket for a 6.5-inch tablet when rolled
Zip pocket, phone pocket and rear zip pocket
dimensions: Open: 54 × 30.5 × 8 cm. Rolled: 35 × 30.5 cm. Rear pocket: 21 × 22 cm.
notes: Confirm current stock and weight before publishing.

name: The Blossom Purse
summary: A compact leather wristlet with hand-cut floral details.
description: A practical everyday purse with a distinctive, expressive character. Each piece features hand-cut leather flowers with button-stud centers. Flowers are crafted from repurposed leather offcuts.

name: The Continental Bifold
summary: A compact bifold wallet with folded-edge construction.
description: A practical bifold format with a compact footprint. Each edge is folded and stitched for durability. The integrated zippered coin compartment eliminates the need for a separate coin purse.

name: The Apex Cardholder
summary: A minimalist cardholder with angled V-slots for effortless access.
description: Precision meets minimalism. The angled V-cut slots guide your thumb naturally, while the three-layer design keeps the profile ultra-slim. A concealed central pocket holds folded cash or extra cards.

name: The Offcut Origami Bifold
summary: A sustainable bifold made from leather offcuts, with a unique interior.
description: Customers choose the exterior cover colour. Interior pocket colours are assorted from available offcuts and cannot be selected individually. No two pieces are exactly alike.
materials: Repurposed leather offcuts (suede, Crazy Horse, full-grain)
colours: Cover: Black, Tan, Olive, Ruby, Hazelnut, Indigo

name: The Voyager Scroll Pack
summary: A vintage-inspired backpack with hand-scrolled leather edges.
description: Crafted from rugged Crazy Horse leather, its defining feature is the masterfully rolled edges that emulate aged parchment. The bag develops a unique patina over time.

name: The Grand Luna Pouch
summary: A spacious moon bag with all-metal gold hardware.
description: A large moon bag with a padded cotton twill lining and a built-in key holder on the zip pull. All-metal gold zips are used throughout, including the inner lining pocket.

name: The Urban Scout Sling
summary: A medium sling bag in Crazy Horse leather with turned construction.
description: A rugged, stylish go-bag with clean turned-out seams and antique brass hardware. The adjustable leather strap can be swapped for an optional webbing strap.

name: The Wildflower Moon Sling
summary: A convertible crossbody bag with leather flowers from repurposed offcuts.
description: A bohemian crossbody with hand-cut leather flowers, available in raw or refined finishes. The adjustable strap is detachable, and a built-in 3-slot card holder keeps essentials organized.

name: The Bold Shopper
summary: A modular tote with interchangeable tassels and a detachable crossbody pocket.
description: A transformative tote with a leather base, canvas body, and Melton wool lining. Reconfigure it to match your day—swap tassels, detach the pocket, or wear it crossbody.

name: The Mint Shopper
summary: A raw-edge leather tote with a hidden snaphook for keys.
description: An unlined, raw-edge tote that celebrates the natural character of leather. A hidden brass snaphook inside keeps keys secure and accessible.

name: The Canvas Crest Tote
summary: A hybrid tote with a leather base, canvas body, and Melton wool lining.
description: A sophisticated tote with a seamless leather top cuff and concealed magnetic closure. The leather top cuff folds inward, marrying lining to body without a visible stitch.

name: The Core Cardholder
summary: A minimalist six-slot cardholder with a central cash pocket.
description: Distilled to its purest form. A central slot for folded cash and six card pockets. The ultra-slim profile is front-pocket friendly.

name: The Flat iPad Sleeve
summary: A slim, customizable iPad sleeve in Crazy Horse leather.
description: An A4-sized envelope sleeve with a D-ring closure. Choose raw edge (unlined) or folded edge (lined and padded). Hardware color is customizable.

name: The Envelope Pro Sleeve
summary: A padded MacBook sleeve with a unique push-clip clasp.
description: Bespoke protection with folded leather edges and 1cm padding. The patent-pending push-clip clasp provides instant access and secure closure.
